objective: Measure stochastic stability of the common-snapshot symmetric continuation result without changing tasks, states, prompts, endpoints, or eligibility.

eligibility.rule: Inherited unchanged from protocol 26; no repeat outcome can alter inclusion.

design.consumer: Codex CLI gpt-5.6-sol, medium reasoning, ephemeral session

validity.valid_session: agent session reaches evaluation and both future and prior verifiers have an observed result
validity.infrastructure_or_setup_failure: quarantine and rerun the identical key
validity.required_unique_keys: 5 pairs x 3 states x 2 new repeats

analysis.primary_endpoint: joint future success with prior-task preservation
analysis.primary_estimand: within-pair mean candidate success minus historical success, averaging s0/s1 and all three repeats
analysis.interpretation: The repeat panel estimates stability on the frozen five-pair sample; it does not enlarge repository coverage.

claude: deferred; when available it will use the unchanged protocol-26 manifest and task interface.
